repo-mpk249-universal-map.name: MPK249 Universal Map
repo-mpk249-universal-map.status: Hardware-ready beta · requires live device testing
repo-mpk249-universal-map.description: Reusable Akai MPK249 mappings and templates for desktop synthesizers and Synth One on iOS. Offline tests pass, but the actual MPK249 and target devices have not been verified.
tasks: Test a backed-up MPK249 hardware preset with the actual MIDI controller.
Verify mapping and safe installation on the Mac and iOS Synth One.
Confirm Bespoke and Vital integration on real target applications.

repo-maze-seedling-rejuvenation.name: MAZE · Seedling Rejuvenation
repo-maze-seedling-rejuvenation.description: An independent replacement companion for the discontinued Seedling marble maze app: construct an 18×18 maze, explore it, try Cardboard view, or assist scanning a physical board.
tasks: Verify real iPhone Safari navigation, touch controls, and persistence.
Test physical-maze photo scanning and manual correction.
Verify Cardboard motion control, offline mode and two-phone pairing on real devices.

repo-sphero-laboratory.name: Sphero Laboratory
repo-sphero-laboratory.description: Local-network browser controller for Sphero 2.0 and SPRK+ through a Mac Bluetooth bridge. Includes software demo mode; simultaneous real-robot operation remains unverified.
tasks: Verify SPRK+ Bluetooth discovery and movement on a Mac.
Test actual Sphero 2.0 legacy serial connection.
Test safe stopping and simultaneous two-robot operation.
Test iPhone Safari controls and battery/sensor reporting.

repo-escape-team-activate.name: Escape Team Activate
repo-escape-team-activate.description: Original printable puzzle missions intended for Escape Team; one- and two-checkpoint prototypes exist as source notes, but no completed, playtested mission is released.
tasks: Finish a paper prototype with all necessary source and printable files in the repository.
Run blind paper playtests and verify answer logic.
Test a completed five-checkpoint mission in the official app.

repo-key-scratch.name: Ortholinear (Key Scratch)
repo-key-scratch.description: An ortholinear iPhone/iPad keyboard with many languages, adjustable geometry, on-device glide typing, local text replacements, and a containing test app. Requires Xcode and device signing to install; no public App Store distribution is verified.
tasks: Build and install on a real iPhone; test the system keyboard extension, glide typing and autocorrection.
Verify text replacement and notes behavior in several host apps.
Check iPad layouts and accessibility on physical hardware.
